{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()

# Check unique sites
unique_sites = data['site'].unique()

# Check response rate by site
response_rates = data.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rates_sorted = response_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

missing_values, unique_sites, response_rates_sorted"}
